text: hello. i need you to write me up a one liner to be able to transfer all the on disk code / models / game data / anything that would be necessary to load something in cart/editor for between here and my macbook. here is the address of where it is on my mac, ideally i want to be able to quickly when on my network, transfer between my desktop or my macbook and not need to worry about anything that github wants to make a fuss about; so what do u think we can do to just have it oneshot and transfer over the network;  here is the address smb://mbp.local/josiahprice/reactjit
resolution: Finished the one-shot local-network transfer design after removing the false hmsc-int dependency. The rsync payload mirrors the working source tree plus cart/editor's ignored reference cache and the real authored state under zig-out/game/editor + contentstore, while protecting Mac-native deps/tools and excluding Git, caches, build outputs, retired carts, archives, backups, and unrelated stacks. The filter set was dry-run validated at 8,202 files / 350,117,764 bytes. Uses the supplied SMB share through gio/GVFS, with timestamped destination backups so overwritten/deleted files remain recoverable. Package-only editor ownership shipped in the cited commits.
